company_data.company_description: Special Products & Mfg., Inc. (SPM) is a contract manufacturing company providing medium and large growing OEM's with manufacturing services and solutions. We specialize in electro-mechanical assembly, precision metal fabrication, machining, welding, and powder coating. We provide our customers in various industries with a variety of products. From our humble beginnings in a garage shop we grew and moved into larger facilities in Dallas, Garland, and lastly into our current home in Rockwall, Texas. We currently operate in a state-of-the-art 140,000 square foot facility in the prominent Rockwall Technology Park.  Our Mission: To consistently deliver innovative and efficient contract manufacturing solutions that provide our customers with a competitive advantage.  Our Vision:  To be recognized as an innovator of world class manufacturing processes, people development and contract manufacturing solutions that provide a competitive edge for our customers globally. company_data.company_description: Areco is a privately owned Swedish company founded in 1944 and today is one of the leading players in the sheet metal industry. Areco Steel is the parent company of the privately-owned Areco Group, which also includes the five divisions: Areco Metals, Areco Industry, Areco Profiles, Areco Direct and Areco Properties with approx. 400 employees in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland and Poland. Our business concept is to develop, manufacture, and globally market products and services to the construction industry based on customer needs. Customers are served in 25 countries.

Cutting Edge Fabrication (CEF) is an ISO 9001:2015 certified metal fabrication company specializing in welding medium to large metal structures and components. The company has been conducting business since 1990 in Milwaukee, WI. CEF fabrication services include welding, metal forming, metal bending, plate cutting, laser cutting, plasma cutting, oxy-fuel cutting, sheering, production sawing, CNC machining, and final assembly. CEF fabrication capabilities include processing raw material to finished product fabrications, state-of-the-art laser plate cutting, high-performance production sawing, precision CNC machining, full assembly services, and quality inspection. Cutting Edge Fabrication’s high-level of customer satisfaction results from providing the highest-quality metal fabrication products and services available. We continuously strive to excel in all manufacturing processes utilizing the best quality standards, ongoing workforce training and well-maintained production equipment. Our dedication to quality is absolute and without compromise as we focus on delivering 100% customer satisfaction.
company_specialties: complete raw processing to finished product fabrications

company_data.company_description: JK Welding is a full service welding company offering custom fabrication, welding and metal repair to clients in Houston, San Antonio, Austin, Dallas, and the surrounding areas. Our professional welding fabricators provide superior service in our welding shop and field service. Our Section IV, AWS or DNV certified welders are committed to the highest standard of quality workmanship and have the attention to detail needed to ensure your satisfaction. Our experienced welding fabricators, metal workers, and professional shop artists are highly trained, knowledgeable, and experienced at their craft. We have decades of experience and technical skill to handle any custom fabrication job for all commercial and industrial applications, including complete design, installation, and repair services.

MacDonald Steel, founded in 1957, is a custom steel fabrication and machining plant. Our facility sits on 20 acres of land and the plant floor consists of 190 sq ft of fabrication space. MacDonald Steel includes three divisions; Custom Fabricating, Environmental Systems Division and Specialty Products. The custom fabrication side of our business manufactures products to our customers’ drawings and specifications. We manufacture parts weighing only a few pounds to items that require special permitting to ship due to size or weight. Our facility provides one stop shopping for our customers. Environmental Systems division designs, manufactures, installs and services our own dust collectors (Shaker, Reverse Air, Pulse), Cyclones, Rotary Air Locks, Fans, Spark Systems and Bin Covers. Our 50 years of experience is leveraged to offer our customers an exceptional line of products to suit their application. The Specialty Products division combines the disciplines of design, manufacturing, installation and commissioning of brew-on-the premise systems and equipment. Our brew-on premise equipment packages are built to the highest standard in the industry. MacDonald Steel personnel and welding procedures are certified to CSA W47.1 in the fusion welding of steel products. We have earned American Society for Mechanical Engineers Certification as well as Ontario Technical Standards and Safety Act certification in pressure vessel manufacturing and repairs.

Hadrian is building autonomous factories that help aerospace and defense companies manufacture rockets, satellites, jets, and ships up to 10x faster and up to 2x cheaper. By combining advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we are reinventing how America produces its most critical parts. We recently raised $260 million dollar Series C to accelerate this mission. We are excited to be launching a new Factory in Mesa, Arizona, a square foot facility that will create 350 new jobs immediately. We are opening a new headquarters to support thousands of future hires, launching Hadrian Maritime to serve naval production, and introducing a Factory-as-a-Service model that delivers complete systems instead of individual parts. Hadrian works with startups, Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers, and major defense contractors across space, shipbuilding, and aviation to scale production, reduce costs, and accelerate delivery on mission-critical programs. We are backed by leading investors including Lux Capital, Founders Fund, and Andreessen Horowitz. Our fast-growing team is united by a shared mission to reindustrialize American manufacturing for the 21st century and beyond! company_data.company_description: At EVS Metal, we’re proud to be a leader in precision sheet metal fabrication, dedicated to delivering exceptional manufacturing solutions across the U.S. Our commitment to quality and innovation has fueled our rapid and consistent growth, with over square feet of production space spread across four states—New Jersey, Texas, New Hampshire, and Pennsylvania. This extensive footprint allows us to provide outstanding service to clients throughout North America, covering regions such as the Northeast, Mid-Atlantic, South, and beyond. Whether it’s for industries like defense, telecommunications, or industrial equipment, we’re here to meet every sheet metal fabrication need with precision and efficiency. Our full-service offerings include: • CNC Punching, Laser Cutting, and Machining • Robotic Forming, Stamping, and Welding • Automated Powder Coating and Finishing • Assembly, Integration, and Logistics Support At EVS Metal, we go beyond production with engineering support, design consultation, and inventory management, providing a true end-to-end manufacturing experience. Our team stands behind every project, ensuring superior craftsmanship, reliability, and value from start to finish. Let us help bring your vision to life with precision and expertise unmatched in the industry.

BEGNEAUD was founded in 1978 as a fabrication job shop. Today, as a job shop and contract manufacturer, we continue to meet our clients’ sheet metal fabrication needs. We combine our precision laser cutting and bending services with the talent of skilled welders, fabricators and finishers to provide clients with low to high volume sheet metal fabrication parts. Our services include Services CNC laser cutting, CNC punching, metal forming, stainless steel and aluminum fabrication, thread cleaning, and exotic alloys welding. Industries that we serve include:* Agriculture * Defense * Food & Beverage * Original Equipment Manufacturers * Automotive * Electronics * Manufacturing * Telecommunications * Architecture * Energy * Medical * Transportation To learn more about BEGNEAUD Manufacturing, please visit

For 55 years the Prince name has been synonymous with quality metalwork. Servicing the customer with a superior product on time has been an unchanging goal for the company from its humble beginnings in founder Joe Prince’s garage as Prince Sheet Metal to its current state as a cutting edge business employing over 100 skilled workers and utilizing multiple facilities equipped with state of the art machinery. While the look and size of the company has changed, its goals and underlying focus have not, to serve our customers. Founded originally around a business model of fast response to local industry shut down work and providing an array of metal fabrication to support the community and satisfy the customer, Prince Sheet Metal earned a hard-fought reputation as being willing to serve. This approach has been passed down through generations and is now also applied to production run parts with an equal sense of urgency, accountability and reliability at each of its two current locations. Prince Service and Manufacturing (PSM) focuses on heavy metal fabrication and industrial service work, targeting a similar market as the original company. Prince Precision Products is an ISO 9001:2015 certified facility that started in 2008 to focus on larger volume sheet metal fabrication. The two facilities complement each other well and the resulting organization is one that has the flexibility, skill and manpower to provide solutions to nearly any problem in the metal fabrication industry across the southeastern United States. At Prince we value partnerships forged over time. We maintain focus on our customers and strive to be the company our customers turn to when they have a problem, understanding that satisfied customers come back again and again to do business. For any metal parts ranging from intricate, tight tolerance machining to heavy plate fabrication of large weldments, we want to be that trusted partner you turn to.

Metalex is a no-nonsense, performance-driven, high quality, advanced technology contract machine shop trusted by leading companies across multiple industries to solve problems, and attain their goals, often under difficult cost and time constraints. Founded in 1971, Metalex is a privately held shop located in Cincinnati, Ohio that has grown into one of America's leading contract machine shops. We embrace challenging, first-time projects and prototypes for high-tech needs as well as production runs for commercial applications. Quality, craftsmanship, and service are the culture and character of our company.

Taylor Manufacturing is a Custom Metal Fabricator. Offering Machining Services and Metal Fabrication, Laser Cutting, Plasma & Oxy-Fuel Cutting, Time Saver, Press Brakes, Welding (Manual & Robotic (Mig & Tig), Powder Coating, Machining, Sawing, Turning & Milling.

Founded in 1974 in Lincoln, Nebraska, TMCO has grown from a small machine shop into a total contract manufacturer with more than 230 employees. For over 50 years, we’ve helped companies bring ideas to life with concept-to-completion manufacturing solutions. Our capabilities span engineering, prototyping, CNC machining, metal fabrication, tube fabrication, welding, powder coating and assembly—all under one roof. TMCO is ISO 9001:2015 certified and ITAR compliant, ensuring the highest standards of quality, precision, and security across industries. We serve diverse industries that drive the future, including agriculture, energy, bioscience, defense, and custom manufacturing. From high-volume production to one-off custom parts, TMCO combines advanced technology with craftsmanship and care. Who We Are TMCO is a second-generation woman-owned, and minority-owned family business built on values of open-minded innovation, attention to detail, collaboration, loyalty, excellence, positivity and purpose. These principles guide how we operate, build partnerships, and engage with our community. Led by CEO Diane Temme Stinton, TMCO continues to grow to meet the challenges of its customers. Recognized as Nebraska Manufacturer of the Year (2023), we are committed to innovation, pursuing the highest industry standards, and positively impacting our community. At TMCO, we don’t just manufacture parts—we build partnerships and solve complex problems together leveraging the latest technology. Metal reimagined.

The Jor-Mac Company is an established contract manufacturer of engineered metal fabrications and electromechanical-assemblies for a diversified Fortune "Blue Chip" customer base and has been serving the industrial marketplace since 1952. Our company provides comprehensive metal fabrication, machining, laser cutting and powder painting services. Jor-Mac’s State-of-the-Art Manufacturing Facility is centrally located in Lomira, WI. We operate as a sole source vendor to many leading OEM’s and provide our customers with high-quality, competitive pricing and on-time delivery performance. Jor-Mac is ISO 9001:2015 quality certified, ISO 14001:2004 environmental compliance certified and DuPont Star Coater Certified.

Ben Machine is a fully integrated advanced manufacturing facility offering sophisticated 3, 4 and 5 axis CNC milling, CNC turning, precision sheet metal fabrication, welding, assembly and finishing services for the military, defense, aerospace, and high tech commercial industries. Ben Machine is registered under the Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and fully compliant with International Trade in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Our quality system is certified to AS9100 and ISO 9001 standards and we are active members of the Ontario Aerospace Council and the Canadian Association of Defence and Security Industries. Ben Machine was founded in 1973 as a small tool and die shop for the investment casting industry. Since its founding, Ben Machine has remained an industry leader, expanding into CNC machining, turning, and sheet metal operations. We specialize in Defence, Aerospace, Medical, and Nuclear solutions. We meet CGP, ITAR, and AS9100 standards. Today, we are a fully integrated solutions provider that uses the latest manufacturing technology to provide our customers with complete quality precision parts, faster lead times, and competitive pricing. As we continue to grow, we are steadily upgrading our technological capabilities and broadening our services to provide a one-stop-shop for all of your sub-contracting needs. Think of Ben Machine as an extension of your company. We have invested millions of dollars into our current plant and equipment, and we continue to grow. Housed in over square feet over 2 facilities, we offer all services under on site. With significant room to expand, we can easily double our capacity overnight. Our team of experts includes more than 210 highly skilled tradespeople, engineers, management, and support staff to see your projects from inception to completion. And as a division of Exchange Income Corporation, we can leverage our sister companies, PAL Aerospace and DECA Aviation, to add even more value.

Wesgar is the fastest growing custom precision sheet metal fabricator and the largest producer of high-mix, low-volume products in Western Canada and the Pacific Northwest. A specialist in identifying and solving the unique challenges and complex needs of each customer, Wesgar crafts tailored solutions, such as managing spikes and variable demand, reducing cycle times, managing compound quality and technical requirements, lowering costs, and mitigating supply chain disruptions—allowing our customers to meet and deliver to their customers’ exacting standards. Our world-class, square feet plant, located on Wesgar’s four-acre campus, boasts $30 million in state-of-the-art sheet metal and copper fabrication equipment. Wesgar's unrivaled range of services, intended to eliminate obstacles to success, include design for manufacturability, prototype production, fabrication, finishing, assembly, machining, stringent quality inspection and documentation, inventory and stocking programs, and logistical services. Wesgar’s one-stop shop satisfies the industry’s high demands. Our more than 200 fabrication experts, engineers, metal technologists, and quality control professionals work around the clock as a cohesive team to precisely oversee the dependable delivery of thousands of precision items manufactured in light gauge steel, aluminum, stainless steel, and copper. Energy storage and backup power systems, power distribution, OEMs, commercial electronics, telecommunications, medical, industrial and automation, clean and renewable energy, security, recreation, and other industries are among those we serve. Wesgar values long-term customer relationships and is proud to count EnerSys, Rockwell Automation, Ballard Power, Kodak, Thermo Fisher Scientific, and Honeywell as customers who rely on us to deliver unrivaled responsiveness, responsiveness, collaborative engineering, innovative and accurate precision fabrication, and a flexible approach.

At Marcon, we engineer, build, and install complex structural solutions with uncompromising integrity. We’ve enabled infrastructure to stand and span by engineering the details that enable dynamic movements and reinforce structural integrity. Marcon’s proficiency in bridge and structural connection design enable collaboration with contractors at the design phase to offer creative improvements that strengthen structural integrity and optimize production costs. We employ one of the largest drafting teams in the Pacific Northwest to facilitate the translation from engineering to production. Milieu by Marcon translates concepts into reality. Milieu is the architectural extension of Marcon Metal Fabrication. Where metal meets art to elevate public perception and where we manufacture social space.
